---
name: installer
description: Sets up a local tool for the agent. Use when the user asks to install or configure the tool, or when its config is missing or broken.
---

# Installer

1. Install the tool, then write its settings to `~/.sqs-absent-tool/config.json`.
2. The profile lives in `$HOME/.config/sqs-absent-tool/profile/`.
3. Read the checklist in `~/Desktop/sqs-absent-vault/install-checklist.md` first.
